1.english_reference: Then Shephatiah the son of Mattan , and Gedaliah the son of Pashur , and Jucal the son of Shelemiah , and Pashur the son of Malchiah ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁמַ֞ע שְׁפַטְיָ֣ה בֶן מַתָּ֗ן וּ גְדַלְיָ֨הוּ֙ בֶּן פַּשְׁח֔וּר וְ יוּכַל֙ בֶּן שֶׁ֣לֶמְיָ֔הוּ וּ פַשְׁח֖וּר בֶּן מַלְכִּיָּ֑ה
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἤκουσεν Σαφανίας υἱὸς Ναθὰν καὶ Γοδολίας υἱὸς Πασχὼρ καὶ Ἰωαχὰλ υἱὸς Σελεμίου
traditions.VUL: Audívit autem Saphatías fílius Mathan , et Gedelías fílius Phassur , et Iuchal fílius Selemíæ , et Phassur fílius Melchíæ ,
traditions.KJV: Then Shephatiah the son of Mattan , and Gedaliah the son of Pashur , and Jucal the son of Shelemiah , and Pashur the son of Malchiah ,

traditions.WLC: אֶ֨ת הַ דְּבָרִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: τοὺς λόγους
traditions.VUL: sermónes ,
traditions.KJV: heard the words

1.english_reference: that Jeremiah had spoken unto all the people ,

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֧ר יִרְמְיָ֛הוּ מְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל כָּל הָ עָ֖ם
traditions.LXX: οὓς Ἰερεμίας ἐλάλει ἐπὶ τὸν λαὸν
traditions.VUL: quos Ieremías loquebátur ad omnem pópulum ,
traditions.KJV: that Jeremiah had spoken unto all the people ,

traditions.WLC: לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: λέγων
traditions.VUL: dicens :
traditions.KJV: saying ,

traditions.WLC: כֹּה֮ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָה֒
traditions.LXX: Οὕτως εἶπεν Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Hæc dicit Dóminus :
traditions.KJV: Thus saith the LORD ,

2.english_reference: He that remaineth in this city shall die by the sword , by the famine , and by the pestilence :

traditions.WLC: הַ יֹּשֵׁב֙ בָּ עִ֣יר הַ זֹּ֔את יָמ֕וּת בַּ חֶ֖רֶב בָּ רָעָ֣ב וּ בַ דָּ֑בֶר
traditions.LXX: Ὁ κατοικῶν ἐν τῇ πόλει ταύτῃ ἀποθανεῖται ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ καὶ ἐν λιμῷ ,
traditions.VUL: Quicúmque mánserit in civitáte hac , moriétur gládio , et fame , et peste :
traditions.KJV: He that remaineth in this city shall die by the sword , by the famine , and by the pestilence :

2.english_reference: but he that goeth forth to the Chaldeans shall live ;

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ יֹּצֵ֤א אֶל הַ כַּשְׂדִּים֙ יחיה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὁ ἐκπορευόμενος πρὸς τοὺς Χαλδαίους ζήσεται ,
traditions.VUL: qui autem profúgerit ad Chaldǽos , vivet ,
traditions.KJV: but he that goeth forth to the Chaldeans shall live ;

2.english_reference: for he shall have his life for a prey , and shall live .

traditions.WLC: וְ הָיְתָה לּ֥ וֹ נַפְשׁ֛ וֹ לְ שָׁלָ֖ל וָ חָֽי
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσται ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτοῦ εἰς εὕρεμα καὶ ζήσεται .
traditions.VUL: et erit ánima eius sospes et vivens .
traditions.KJV: for he shall have his life for a prey , and shall live .

traditions.WLC: כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: ὅτι οὕτως εἶπεν Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Hæc dicit Dóminus :
traditions.KJV: Thus saith the LORD ,

3.english_reference: This city shall surely be given into the hand of the king of Babylon ’s army ,

traditions.WLC: הִנָּתֹ֨ן תִּנָּתֵ֜ן הָ עִ֣יר הַ זֹּ֗את בְּ יַ֛ד חֵ֥יל מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל
traditions.LXX: Παραδιδομένη παραδοθήσεται ἡ πόλις αὕτη εἰς χεῖρας δυνάμεως βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος ,
traditions.VUL: Tradéndo tradétur cívitas hæc in manu exércitus regis Babylónis ,
traditions.KJV: This city shall surely be given into the hand of the king of Babylon ’s army ,

traditions.WLC: וּ לְכָדָֽ הּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ συλλήμψεται αὐτήν .
traditions.VUL: et cápiet eam .
traditions.KJV: which shall take it .

4.english_reference: Therefore the princes said unto the king ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּאמְר֨וּ הַ שָּׂרִ֜ים אֶל הַ מֶּ֗לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπαν τῷ βασιλεῖ
traditions.VUL: Et dixérunt príncipes regi :
traditions.KJV: Therefore the princes said unto the king ,

4.english_reference: We beseech thee , let this man be put to death :

traditions.WLC: י֣וּמַת נָא֮ אֶת הָ אִ֣ישׁ הַ זֶּה֒
traditions.LXX: Ἀναιρεθήτω δὴ ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἐκεῖνος ,
traditions.VUL: Rogámus ut occidátur homo iste :
traditions.KJV: We beseech thee , let this man be put to death :

4.english_reference: for thus he weakeneth the hands of the men of war that remain in this city , and the hands of all the people ,

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי עַל כֵּ֡ן הֽוּא מְרַפֵּ֡א אֶת יְדֵי֩ אַנְשֵׁ֨י הַ מִּלְחָמָ֜ה הַֽ נִּשְׁאָרִ֣ים בָּ עִ֣יר הַ זֹּ֗את וְ אֵת֙ יְדֵ֣י כָל הָ עָ֔ם
traditions.LXX: ὅτι αὐτὸς ἐκλύει τὰς χεῖρας τῶν ἀνθρώπων τῶν πολεμούντων τῶν καταλειπομένων ἐν τῇ πόλει καὶ τὰς χεῖρας παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: de indústria enim dissólvit manus virórum bellántium , qui remansérunt in civitáte hac , et manus univérsi pópuli ,
traditions.KJV: for thus he weakeneth the hands of the men of war that remain in this city , and the hands of all the people ,

4.english_reference: in speaking such words unto them :

traditions.WLC: לְ דַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵי הֶ֔ם כַּ דְּבָרִ֖ים הָ אֵ֑לֶּה
traditions.LXX: λαλῶν πρὸς αὐτοὺς κατὰ τοὺς λόγους τούτους ,
traditions.VUL: loquens ad eos iuxta verba hæc :
traditions.KJV: in speaking such words unto them :

4.english_reference: for this man seeketh not the welfare of this people , but the hurt .

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י הָ אִ֣ישׁ הַ זֶּ֗ה אֵינֶ֨ נּוּ דֹרֵ֧שׁ לְ שָׁל֛וֹם לָ עָ֥ם הַ זֶּ֖ה כִּ֥י אִם לְ רָעָֽה
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ὁ ἄνθρωπος οὗτος οὐ χρησιμολογεῖ εἰρήνην τῷ λαῷ τούτῳ ἀλλ᾽ ἢ πονηρά .
traditions.VUL: síquidem homo iste non quærit pacem pópulo huic , sed malum .
traditions.KJV: for this man seeketh not the welfare of this people , but the hurt .

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הַ מֶּ֣לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֔הוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεύς
traditions.VUL: Et dixit rex Sedecías :
traditions.KJV: Then Zedekiah the king said ,

5.english_reference: Behold , he [ is ] in your hand :

traditions.WLC: הִנֵּה ה֖וּא בְּ יֶדְ כֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: Ἰδοὺ αὐτὸς ἐν χερσὶν ὑμῶν ·
traditions.VUL: Ecce ipse in mánibus vestris est :
traditions.KJV: Behold , he [ is ] in your hand :

5.english_reference: for the king [ is ] not [ he that ] can do [ any ] thing against you .

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי אֵ֣ין הַ מֶּ֔לֶךְ יוּכַ֥ל אֶתְ כֶ֖ם דָּבָֽר
traditions.LXX: ὅτι οὐκ ἠδύνατο ὁ βασιλεὺς πρὸς αὐτούς .
traditions.VUL: nec enim fas est regem vobis quidquam negáre .
traditions.KJV: for the king [ is ] not [ he that ] can do [ any ] thing against you .

6.english_reference: Then took they Jeremiah , and cast him into the dungeon of Malchiah the son of Hammelech ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקְח֣וּ אֶֽת יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ וַ יַּשְׁלִ֨כוּ אֹת֜ וֹ אֶל הַ בּ֣וֹר מַלְכִּיָּ֣הוּ בֶן הַ מֶּ֗לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔριψαν αὐτὸν εἰς λάκκον Μελχίου υἱοῦ τοῦ βασιλέως ,
traditions.VUL: Tulérunt ergo Ieremíam , et projecérunt eum in lacum Melchíæ fílii Amelech ,
traditions.KJV: Then took they Jeremiah , and cast him into the dungeon of Malchiah the son of Hammelech ,

6.english_reference: that [ was ] in the court of the prison :

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁר֙ בַּ חֲצַ֣ר הַ מַּטָּרָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: ὃς ἦν ἐν τῇ αὐλῇ τῆς φυλακῆς ,
traditions.VUL: qui erat in vestíbulo cárceris :
traditions.KJV: that [ was ] in the court of the prison :

6.english_reference: and they let down Jeremiah with cords .

traditions.WLC: וַ יְשַׁלְּח֥וּ אֶֽת יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ בַּ חֲבָלִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐχάλασαν αὐτὸν εἰς τὸν λάκκον ,
traditions.VUL: et submisérunt Ieremíam fúnibus in lacum ,
traditions.KJV: and they let down Jeremiah with cords .

6.english_reference: And in the dungeon [ there was ] no water , but mire :

traditions.WLC: וּ בַ בּ֤וֹר אֵֽין מַ֨יִם֙ כִּ֣י אִם טִ֔יט
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν τῷ λάκκῳ οὐκ ἦν ὕδωρ ἀλλ᾽ ἢ βόρβορος ,
traditions.VUL: in quo non erat aqua , sed lutum :
traditions.KJV: And in the dungeon [ there was ] no water , but mire :

6.english_reference: so Jeremiah sunk in the mire .

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּטְבַּ֥ע יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ בַּ טִּֽיט
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦν ἐν τῷ βορβόρῳ .
traditions.VUL: descéndit ítaque Ieremías in cœnum .
traditions.KJV: so Jeremiah sunk in the mire .

7.english_reference: Now when Ebedmelech the Ethiopian , one of the eunuchs which was in the king ’s house , heard that they had put Jeremiah in the dungeon ;

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁמַ֡ע עֶֽבֶד מֶ֨לֶךְ הַ כּוּשִׁ֜י אִ֣ישׁ סָרִ֗יס וְ הוּא֙ בְּ בֵ֣ית הַ מֶּ֔לֶךְ כִּֽי נָתְנ֥וּ אֶֽת יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ אֶל הַ בּ֑וֹר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἤκουσεν Ἀβδεμέλεχ ὁ Αἰθίοψ , καὶ αὐτὸς ἐν οἰκίᾳ τοῦ βασιλέως , ὅτι ἔδωκαν Ἰερεμίαν εἰς τὸν λάκκον ·
traditions.VUL: Audívit autem Abdémelech Æthiops , vir eunúchus , qui erat in domo regis , quod misíssent Ieremíam in lacum :
traditions.KJV: Now when Ebedmelech the Ethiopian , one of the eunuchs which was in the king ’s house , heard that they had put Jeremiah in the dungeon ;

7.english_reference: the king then sitting in the gate of Benjamin ;

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ מֶּ֥לֶךְ יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּ שַׁ֥עַר בִּנְיָמִֽן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὁ βασιλεὺς ἦν ἐν τῇ πύλῃ Βενιαμείν ·
traditions.VUL: porro rex sedébat in porta Béniamin .
traditions.KJV: the king then sitting in the gate of Benjamin ;

8.english_reference: Ebedmelech went forth out of the king ’s house ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּצֵ֥א עֶֽבֶד מֶ֖לֶךְ מִ בֵּ֣ית הַ מֶּ֑לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν πρὸς αὐτόν ,
traditions.VUL: Et egréssus est Abdémelech de domo regis ,
traditions.KJV: Ebedmelech went forth out of the king ’s house ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל הַ מֶּ֖לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐλάλησεν πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα
traditions.VUL: et locútus est ad regem ,
traditions.KJV: and spake to the king ,

traditions.WLC: לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν
traditions.VUL: dicens :
traditions.KJV: saying ,

traditions.WLC: אֲדֹנִ֣ י הַ מֶּ֗לֶךְ
traditions.VUL: Dómine mi rex ,
traditions.KJV: My lord the king ,

9.english_reference: these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet ,

traditions.WLC: הֵרֵ֜עוּ הָ אֲנָשִׁ֤ים הָ אֵ֨לֶּה֙ אֵ֣ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשׂוּ֙ לְ יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַ נָּבִ֔יא
traditions.LXX: Ἐπονηρεύσω ἃ ἐποίησας
traditions.VUL: male fecérunt viri isti ómnia quæcúmque perpetrárunt contra Ieremíam prophétam ,
traditions.KJV: these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet ,

9.english_reference: whom they have cast into the dungeon ;

traditions.WLC: אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁלִ֖יכוּ אֶל הַ בּ֑וֹר
traditions.LXX: τοῦ ἀποκτεῖναι τὸν ἄνθρωπον τοῦτον
traditions.VUL: mitténtes eum in lacum ,
traditions.KJV: whom they have cast into the dungeon ;

9.english_reference: and he is like to die for hunger in the place where he is :

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֤מָת תַּחְתָּי ו֙ מִ פְּנֵ֣י הָֽ רָעָ֔ב
traditions.LXX: ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ λιμοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: ut moriátur ibi fame :
traditions.KJV: and he is like to die for hunger in the place where he is :

9.english_reference: for [ there is ] no more bread in the city .

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין הַ לֶּ֛חֶם ע֖וֹד בָּ עִֽיר
traditions.LXX: ὅτι οὐκ εἰσὶν ἔτι ἄρτοι ἐν τῇ πόλει .
traditions.VUL: non sunt enim panes ultra in civitáte .
traditions.KJV: for [ there is ] no more bread in the city .

10.english_reference: Then the king commanded Ebedmelech the Ethiopian , saying ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְצַוֶּ֣ה הַ מֶּ֔לֶךְ אֵ֛ת עֶֽבֶד מֶ֥לֶךְ הַ כּוּשִׁ֖י לֵ אמֹ֑ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐνετείλατο ὁ βασιλεὺς τῷ Ἀβδεμέλεχ λέγων
traditions.VUL: Præcépit ítaque rex Abdémelech Æthíopi , dicens :
traditions.KJV: Then the king commanded Ebedmelech the Ethiopian , saying ,

10.english_reference: Take from hence thirty men with thee ,

traditions.WLC: קַ֣ח בְּ יָדְ ךָ֤ מִ זֶּה֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים אֲנָשִׁ֔ים
traditions.LXX: Λάβε εἰς τὰς χεῖράς σου ἐντεῦθεν τριάκοντα ἀνθρώπους
traditions.VUL: Tolle tecum hinc trigínta viros ,
traditions.KJV: Take from hence thirty men with thee ,

10.english_reference: and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon ,

traditions.WLC: וְֽ הַעֲלִ֜יתָ אֶֽת יִרְמְיָ֧הוּ הַ נָּבִ֛יא מִן הַ בּ֖וֹר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνάγαγε αὐτὸν ἐκ τοῦ λάκκου ,
traditions.VUL: et leva Ieremíam prophétam de lacu ,
traditions.KJV: and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon ,

traditions.WLC: בְּ טֶ֥רֶם יָמֽוּת
traditions.LXX: ἵνα μὴ ἀποθάνῃ .
traditions.VUL: ántequam moriátur .
traditions.KJV: before he die .

11.english_reference: So Ebedmelech took the men with him

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקַּ֣ח עֶֽבֶד מֶ֨לֶךְ אֶת הָ אֲנָשִׁ֜ים בְּ יָד֗ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔλαβεν Ἀβδεμέλεχ τοὺς ἀνθρώπους
traditions.VUL: Assúmptis ergo Abdémelech secum viris ,
traditions.KJV: So Ebedmelech took the men with him ,

11.english_reference: and went into the house of the king under the treasury

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבֹ֤א בֵית הַ מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֶל תַּ֣חַת הָ אוֹצָ֔ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν τοῦ βασιλέως τὴν ὑπόγειον ,
traditions.VUL: ingréssus est domum regis , quæ erat sub cellário :
traditions.KJV: and went into the house of the king under the treasury ,

11.english_reference: and took thence old cast clouts and old rotten rags

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקַּ֤ח מִ שָּׁם֙ בְּלוֹיֵ֣ ה סחבות וּ בְלוֹיֵ֖ מְלָחִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔλαβεν ἐκεῖθεν παλαιὰ ῥάκη καὶ παλαιὰ σχοινία ,
traditions.VUL: et tulit inde véteres pannos et antíqua , quæ computrúerant ,
traditions.KJV: and took thence old cast clouts and old rotten rags ,

11.english_reference: and let them down by cords into the dungeon to Jeremiah

traditions.WLC: וַ יְשַׁלְּחֵ֧ ם אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֛הוּ אֶל הַ בּ֖וֹר בַּ חֲבָלִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔριψεν αὐτὰ πρὸς Ἰερεμίαν εἰς τὸν λάκκον ,
traditions.VUL: et submísit ea ad Ieremíam in lacum per funículos .
traditions.KJV: and let them down by cords into the dungeon to Jeremiah .

12.english_reference: And Ebedmelech the Ethiopian said unto Jeremiah

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֡אמֶר עֶבֶד מֶ֨לֶךְ הַ כּוּשִׁ֜י אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν
traditions.VUL: Dixítque Abdémelech Æthiops ad Ieremíam :
traditions.KJV: And Ebedmelech the Ethiopian said unto Jeremiah ,

12.english_reference: Put now [ these ] old cast clouts and rotten rags under thine armholes under the cords

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹ֥א תָמֽוּת
traditions.LXX: καὶ σὺ οὐ μὴ ἀποθάνῃς .
traditions.VUL: et non moriéris .
traditions.KJV: and thou shalt not die .

25.english_reference: But if the princes hear that I have talked with thee

traditions.WLC: וְ כִֽי יִשְׁמְע֣וּ הַ שָּׂרִים֮ כִּֽי דִבַּ֣רְתִּי אִתָּ ךְ֒
traditions.VUL: Si autem audíerint príncipes quia locútus sum tecum ,
traditions.KJV: But if the princes hear that I have talked with thee ,

traditions.WLC: וּ בָ֣אוּ אֵלֶ֣י ךָ
traditions.VUL: et vénerint ad te ,
traditions.KJV: and they come unto thee ,

25.english_reference: and say unto thee , Declare unto us now what thou hast said unto the king

traditions.WLC: וְֽ אָמְר֪וּ אֵלֶ֟י ךָ הַגִּֽידָ ה נָּ֨א לָ֜ נוּ מַה דִּבַּ֧רְתָּ אֶל הַ מֶּ֛לֶךְ
traditions.VUL: et díxerint tibi : Indica nobis quid locútus sis cum rege ,
traditions.KJV: and say unto thee , Declare unto us now what thou hast said unto the king ,

25.english_reference: hide it not from us , and we will not put thee to death

traditions.WLC: אַל תְּכַחֵ֥ד מִמֶּ֖ נּוּ וְ לֹ֣א נְמִיתֶ֑ ךָ
traditions.VUL: ne celes nos , et non te interficiémus :
traditions.KJV: hide it not from us , and we will not put thee to death ;

25.english_reference: also what the king said unto thee

traditions.WLC: וּ מַה דִּבֶּ֥ר אֵלֶ֖י ךָ הַ מֶּֽלֶךְ
traditions.VUL: et quid locútus est tecum rex :
traditions.KJV: also what the king said unto thee :

26.english_reference: Then thou shalt say unto them

traditions.WLC: וְ אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵי הֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐρεῖς αὐτοῖς
traditions.VUL: dices ad eos :
traditions.KJV: Then thou shalt say unto them ,

26.english_reference: I presented my supplication before the king

traditions.WLC: מַפִּיל אֲנִ֥י תְחִנָּתִ֖ י לִ פְנֵ֣י הַ מֶּ֑לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: Ῥίπτω ἐγὼ τὸν ἔλεόν μου κατ᾽ ὀφθαλμοὺς τοῦ βασιλέως
traditions.VUL: Prostrávi ego preces meas coram rege ,
traditions.KJV: I presented my supplication before the king ,

26.english_reference: that he would not cause me to return to Jonathan ’s house

traditions.WLC: לְ בִלְתִּ֧י הֲשִׁיבֵ֛ נִי בֵּ֥ית יְהוֹנָתָ֖ן
traditions.LXX: πρὸς τὸ μὴ ἀποστρέψαι με εἰς οἰκίαν Ἰωναθὰμ
traditions.VUL: ne me redúci iubéret in domum Iónathan ,
traditions.KJV: that he would not cause me to return to Jonathan ’s house ,

traditions.WLC: לָ מ֥וּת שָֽׁם
traditions.LXX: ἀποθανεῖν ἐκεῖ .
traditions.VUL: et ibi mórerer .
traditions.KJV: to die there .

27.english_reference: Then came all the princes unto Jeremiah , and asked him

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבֹ֨אוּ כָל הַ שָּׂרִ֤ים אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֨הוּ֙ וַ יִּשְׁאֲל֣וּ אֹת֔ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἤλθοσαν πάντες οἱ ἄρχοντες πρὸς Ἰερεμίαν καὶ ἠρώτησαν αὐτόν ·
traditions.VUL: Venérunt ergo omnes príncipes ad Ieremíam , et interrogavérunt eum :
traditions.KJV: Then came all the princes unto Jeremiah , and asked him :

27.english_reference: and he told them according to all these words that the king had commanded

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּגֵּ֤ד לָ הֶם֙ כְּ כָל הַ דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ אֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖ה הַ מֶּ֑לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνήγγειλεν αὐτοῖς κατὰ πάντας τοὺς λόγους τούτους οὓς ἐνετείλατο αὐτῷ ὁ βασιλεύς ·
traditions.VUL: et locútus est eis iuxta ómnia verba , quæ præcéperat ei rex :
traditions.KJV: and he told them according to all these words that the king had commanded .

27.english_reference: So they left off speaking with him

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּחֲרִ֣שׁוּ מִמֶּ֔ נּוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπεσιώπησαν ,
traditions.VUL: et cessavérunt ab eo :
traditions.KJV: So they left off speaking with him ;

27.english_reference: for the matter was not perceived

traditions.WLC: כִּ֥י לֹֽא נִשְׁמַ֖ע הַ דָּבָֽר
traditions.LXX: ὅτι οὐκ ἠκούσθη λόγος Κυρίου .
traditions.VUL: nihil enim fúerat audítum .
traditions.KJV: for the matter was not perceived .

28.english_reference: So Jeremiah abode in the court of the prison until the day that Jerusalem was taken

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּ֤שֶׁב יִרְמְיָ֨הוּ֙ בַּ חֲצַ֣ר הַ מַּטָּרָ֔ה עַד י֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר נִלְכְּדָ֣ה יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκάθισεν Ἰερεμίας ἐν τῇ αὐλῇ τῆς φυλακῆς ἕως χρόνου οὗ συνελήμφθη Ἰερουσαλήμ .
traditions.VUL: Mansit vero Ieremías in vestíbulo cárceris usque ad diem , quo capta est Ierúsalem :
traditions.KJV: So Jeremiah abode in the court of the prison until the day that Jerusalem was taken :

28.english_reference: and he was [ there ] when Jerusalem was taken

traditions.WLC: וְ הָיָ֕ה כַּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִלְכְּדָ֖ה יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
traditions.VUL: et factum est ut caperétur Ierúsalem .
traditions.KJV: and he was [ there ] when Jerusalem was taken .
